units.zh: 逆臣下 ○蕭胡睹蕭叠裏得古叠耶律撒剌竹奚回離保蕭特烈
units.en: Rebellious Officials 3: Xiao Hudu, Xiao Dielide, Gudie, Yelü Salazhu, Xi Huilibao, and Xiao Telie
units.literal: Rebellious Officials 3: Xiao Hudu, Xiao Dielide, Gudie, Yelü Salazhu, Xi Huilibao, Xiao Telie

units.zh: 蕭胡睹，字乙辛。
units.en: Xiao Hudu, whose courtesy name was Yixin.
units.literal: Xiao Hudu, courtesy name Yixin.

units.zh: 口吃，視斜，發卷，伯父孝穆見之曰：「是兒狀貌，族中未嘗有。」
units.en: He stuttered, his eyes looked askew, and his hair curled; when his uncle Xiao Xiaomu saw him he said, "This boy's looks are unlike anything our clan has ever produced."
units.literal: He stuttered, his gaze was skewed, and his hair curled; when his uncle Xiao Xiaomu saw him he said, "This boy's appearance is unlike anything our clan has ever had."

units.zh: 及壯，魁梧桀傲，好揚人惡。
units.en: When he grew up he was tall and imposing, fierce and overbearing, and loved to broadcast other people's faults.
units.literal: When he reached maturity he was tall and imposing, fierce and arrogant, and fond of broadcasting others' faults.

units.zh: 重熙中，為祗候郎君。
units.en: During the Chongxi era he served as an attendant gentleman.
units.literal: During the Chongxi era he served as an attendant gentleman.

units.zh: 俄遷興聖宮使，尚秦國長公主，授駙馬都尉。
units.en: Before long he was promoted to commissioner of the Xingsheng Palace, married the eldest princess of Qin, and was appointed imperial son-in-law commandant.
units.literal: Before long he was promoted to commissioner of the Xingsheng Palace, married the eldest princess of Qin, and was appointed imperial son-in-law commandant.

units.zh: 以不諧離婚，復尚齊國公主，為北面林牙。
units.en: Because the marriage had grown discordant he divorced her, then married the princess of Qi and was made a Northern Court linya.
units.literal: Because the marriage was discordant he divorced, then married the princess of Qi and was made a Northern Court linya.

units.zh: 清寧中，歷北、南院樞密副使，代族兄術哲為西北路招討使。
units.en: During Qingning he served in turn as associate privy commissioner of the Northern and Southern Courts, then replaced his clansman Shuzhe as Northwestern Route pacification commissioner.
units.literal: During Qingning he successively held the posts of associate privy commissioner of the Northern and Southern Courts, and replaced his clansman Shuzhe as Northwestern Route pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 時蕭革與蕭阿剌俱為樞密使，不協，革以術哲為阿剌所愛，嫉之。
units.en: At that time Xiao Ge and Xiao Ala were both privy commissioners and did not get along; Ge envied Shuzhe because Ala favored him.
units.literal: At that time Xiao Ge and Xiao Ala were both privy commissioners and were at odds; Ge envied Shuzhe because Ala favored him.

units.zh: 朮哲受代赴闕，先嘗借官粟，留直而去。
units.en: Shuzhe was relieved of his post and went to court; he had earlier borrowed official grain and departed while still owing his commission stipend.
units.literal: Shuzhe was relieved and went to court; he had earlier borrowed official grain and left still owing his commission stipend.

units.zh: 胡睹希革意，發其事，術哲因得罪。
units.en: Hudu, hoping to please Ge, exposed the affair, and Shuzhe was punished as a result.
units.literal: Hudu, hoping to please Ge, exposed the matter, and Shuzhe was punished accordingly.

units.zh: 胡睹又欲要權，歲時獻遺珍玩、畜產於革，二人相愛過於兄弟。
units.en: Hudu also sought to win power; year after year he sent Ge rare curios and livestock, and the two grew as close as brothers.
units.literal: Hudu also sought to seize power; each year he presented Ge with rare objects and livestock, and the two became closer than brothers.

units.zh: 胡睹族弟敵烈為北克，薦國舅詳穩蕭胡篤於胡睹，胡睹見其辨給壯勇，傾心交結。
units.en: Hudu's clansman Dilie served as a Northern ke; he recommended the imperial uncle's detail-stable Xiao Huduo to Hudu, and when Hudu saw how eloquent and bold he was he gave himself wholeheartedly to the friendship.
units.literal: Hudu's clansman Dilie served as a Northern ke; he recommended the imperial uncle's detail-stable Xiao Huduo to Hudu, and when Hudu saw his eloquence and martial courage he devoted himself to befriending him.

units.zh: 每遇休沐，言論終日，人皆怪之。
units.en: Whenever they had a day off they talked from morning to night, and everyone thought it odd.
units.literal: Whenever they had a rest day they talked all day long, and everyone found it strange.

units.zh: 會胡睹同知北院樞密事，奏胡篤及敵烈可用，帝以敵烈為旗鼓拽剌詳穩，胡篤為宿直官。
units.en: When Hudu became associate administrator of Northern Court privy affairs, he memorialized that Huduo and Dilie were fit for service; the emperor appointed Dilie drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable and Huduo a night-duty officer.
units.literal: When Hudu became associate administrator of Northern Court privy affairs, he memorialized that Huduo and Dilie were fit for service; the emperor appointed Dilie drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable and Huduo night-duty officer.

units.zh: 及革構陷其兄阿剌，胡篤陰為之助，時人醜之。
units.en: When Ge framed his elder brother Ala, Huduo secretly helped him, and people of the time despised him for it.
units.literal: When Ge framed his elder brother Ala, Huduo secretly aided him, and people of the time despised him for it.

units.zh: 耶律乙辛知北院樞密事，胡睹位在乙辛下，意怏怏不平。
units.en: Yelü Yixin administered Northern Court privy affairs; Hudu stood below Yixin in rank and was resentful and ill at ease.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin administered Northern Court privy affairs; Hudu ranked below Yixin and was discontent and resentful.

units.zh: 初，胡睹嘗與重元子涅魯古謀逆，欲其速發。
units.en: Earlier Hudu had plotted rebellion with Chongyuan's son Nielugu and wanted him to move quickly.
units.literal: Earlier Hudu had once plotted rebellion with Chongyuan's son Nielugu and wished him to act quickly.

units.zh: 會車駕獵太子山，遂與涅魯古脅弩手軍犯行宮。
units.en: When the emperor hunted at Mount Taizi, he joined Nielugu in coercing the crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
units.literal: When the emperor hunted at Mount Taizi, he joined Nielugu in coercing the crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

units.zh: 既戰，涅魯古中流矢而斃，眾皆逃散。
units.en: Once battle was joined Nielugu was struck by an arrow and died; the whole force fled and scattered.
units.literal: Once battle was joined Nielugu was struck by an arrow and died; the host all fled and scattered.

units.zh: 時同黨耶律撒剌竹適在圍場，聞亂，率獵夫來援。
units.en: At that time their fellow conspirator Yelü Salazhu happened to be at the hunting grounds; hearing of the disturbance, he led huntsmen to reinforce them.
units.literal: At that time their fellow conspirator Yelü Salazhu happened to be at the hunt grounds; hearing of the disturbance, he led huntsmen to reinforce them.

units.zh: 其黨謂胡睹等曰：「我軍甚眾，乘其無備，中夜決戰，事冀有成；
units.en: His confederates said to Hudu and the others, "Our force is very large; if we strike while they are unprepared and fight a decisive battle at midnight, the affair may yet succeed;
units.literal: His confederates said to Hudu and the others, "Our force is very large; if we strike while they are unprepared and fight a decisive battle at midnight, the affair may yet succeed;

units.zh: 若至明日，其誰從我？」
units.en: but if we wait until tomorrow, who will still follow us?"
units.literal: if we wait until tomorrow, who will follow us?"

units.zh: 胡睹曰：「倉卒中黑白不辨，若內外軍相應，則吾事去矣。
units.en: Hudu said, "In the heat of the moment friend and foe cannot be told apart; if the inner and outer armies coordinate, our cause is lost.
units.literal: Hudu said, "In the chaos of the moment friend and foe cannot be distinguished; if the inner and outer armies coordinate, our cause is lost.

units.zh: 黎明而發，何遲之有！」
units.en: To set out at dawn—what delay is there!"
units.literal: To set out at dawn—what delay is there!"

units.zh: 重元聽胡睹之計，令四面巡警待旦。
units.en: Chongyuan followed Hudu's plan and ordered patrols on all four sides to wait until dawn.
units.literal: Chongyuan followed Hudu's plan and ordered patrols on all sides to wait until dawn.

units.zh: 是夜，同黨立重元僭位號，胡睹自為樞密使。
units.en: That night the conspirators set Chongyuan up with a usurped title, and Hudu made himself privy commissioner.
units.literal: That night the conspirators set up Chongyuan with a usurped title; Hudu made himself privy commissioner.

units.zh: 明日戰敗，胡睹被創，單騎遁走，至十七濼，投水死。
units.en: The next day they were defeated; Hudu was wounded, fled alone on horseback to the Seventeen Marshes, and drowned himself.
units.literal: The next day they were defeated in battle; Hudu was wounded, fled alone on horseback, reached the Seventeen Marshes, and drowned himself.

units.zh: 五子，同日誅之。
units.en: His five sons were executed on the same day.
units.literal: His five sons were executed on the same day.

units.zh: 蕭叠裏得，字胡睹堇，國舅少父房之後。
units.en: Xiao Dielide, whose courtesy name was Hudu Jin, was a descendant of the imperial uncle's Lesser Father house.
units.literal: Xiao Dielide, courtesy name Hudu Jin, was a descendant of the imperial uncle's Lesser Father house.

units.zh: 父雙古，尚鈿匿公主，仕至國舅詳穩。
units.en: His father Shuanggu married Princess Dianni and rose to the post of imperial uncle's detail-stable.
units.literal: His father Shuanggu married Princess Dianni and rose to imperial uncle's detail-stable.

units.zh: 叠裏得幼警敏不羈，好射獵。
units.en: Dielide was sharp-witted and unruly as a boy and loved hunting.
units.literal: Dielide in youth was sharp-witted and unrestrained, and loved hunting.

units.zh: 太平中，以外戚補祗候郎君，歷延昌宮使、殿前副點檢。
units.en: During Taiping, as a maternal kinsman he was appointed attendant gentleman and served as Yanchang Palace commissioner and deputy front-hall inspector.
units.literal: During Taiping, as a maternal relative he was appointed attendant gentleman, and served as Yanchang Palace commissioner and deputy front-hall inspector.

units.zh: 重熙十三年伐夏，叠裏得將偏師首入敵境，多所俘掠，遷都點檢，改烏古敵烈部都詳穩。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi, during the campaign against Xia, Dielide led a detached force that was first to enter enemy territory and took many captives and much booty; he was promoted to metropolitan inspector and reassigned as overall detail-stable of the Wugu and Dilie tribes.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi during the campaign against Xia, Dielide led a detached force that first entered enemy territory and took many captives and booty; he was promoted to metropolitan inspector and reassigned as overall detail-stable of the Wugu and Dilie tribes.

units.zh: 十八年，再舉西伐，叠裏得奏：「軍馬器械之事，務在選將，夏人豈為難制，但嚴設斥堠，不用掩襲計，何慮不勝？」
units.en: In the eighteenth year another western campaign was launched; Dielide memorialized, "Matters of horses, arms, and equipment depend on choosing the right generals. Are the Xia people truly so hard to control? Only set scouts strictly and do not rely on surprise raids—why should we fear we cannot win?"
units.literal: In the eighteenth year a western campaign was launched again; Dielide memorialized, "Matters of army mounts and weapons depend on choosing generals; are the Xia people so hard to control? Only set scouts strictly and do not use surprise-raid tactics—why worry about not winning?"

units.zh: 帝曰：「卿其速行，無後軍期。」
units.en: The emperor said, "Set out at once; do not fall behind the army's schedule."
units.literal: The emperor said, "You should set out at once; do not miss the army's schedule."

units.zh: 既而叠裏得失利還，復為都點檢。
units.en: Before long Dielide returned after a setback and was again made metropolitan inspector.
units.literal: Before long Dielide returned after a setback and was again made metropolitan inspector.

units.zh: 十九年，夏人來侵金肅軍，上遣叠裏得率輕兵督戰，至河南三角川，斬候者八人，擒觀察使，以功命知漢人行宮都部署事，出為西南面招討使。
units.en: In the nineteenth year the Xia invaded Jinsu Army; the emperor sent Dielide with light troops to oversee the fighting. At Sanjiaochuan south of the river he beheaded eight scouts and captured a surveillance commissioner; for this merit he was appointed to administer the Han mobile palace deployment and sent out as Southwestern Route pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year the Xia invaded Jinsu Army; the emperor sent Dielide with light troops to oversee the fighting; reaching Sanjiaochuan south of the river, he beheaded eight scouts, captured a surveillance commissioner, and for his merit was appointed to administer the Han mobile palace deployment and sent out as Southwestern Route pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 族弟黃八家奴告其主私議宮掖事，叠裏得寢之。
units.en: A clansman's slave named Huangba reported that his master had privately discussed inner-palace affairs; Dielide suppressed the report.
units.literal: A clansman's slave Huangba reported that his master had privately discussed palace inner matters; Dielide suppressed it.

units.zh: 事覺，決大杖，削爵為民。
units.en: When the affair came to light he was sentenced to heavy cudgeling and stripped of his noble rank to commoner status.
units.literal: When the affair came to light he was sentenced to heavy cudgeling and stripped of rank to commoner status.

units.zh: 清寧中，上以所坐事非叠裏得所犯，起為南京統軍使。
units.en: During Qingning the emperor held that the offense for which he had been punished was not one Dielide had committed, and restored him as Nanjing supreme commander.
units.literal: During Qingning the emperor held that the offense for which he had been punished was not what Dielide had done, and restored him as Nanjing supreme commander.

units.zh: 至是，從重元子涅魯古等亂，敗走被擒，伏誅。
units.en: At this juncture he joined Nielugu and the others in Chongyuan's rebellion, was defeated and fled, was captured, and was executed.
units.literal: At this juncture he joined Nielugu and others in Chongyuan's rebellion, was defeated and fled, was captured, and was executed.

units.zh: 古叠，本宮分人，不知姓氏。
units.en: Gudie was originally from the founding-khan household division; his surname is unknown.
units.literal: Gudie was originally from the founding-khan household division; his surname is unknown.

units.zh: 好戲狎，不喜繩檢。
units.en: He loved playful familiarity and did not care for restraint.
units.literal: He loved playful familiarity and did not like restraint.

units.zh: 膂力過人，善擊鞠。
units.en: His strength surpassed other men's, and he excelled at cuju.
units.literal: His physical strength surpassed others', and he excelled at cuju.

units.zh: 重熙初，為護衛，歷宿直官。
units.en: Early in Chongxi he served as a guardsman and passed through night-duty officer posts.
units.literal: Early in Chongxi he served as a guardsman and passed through night-duty officer posts.

units.zh: 十三年，西征，以古叠為先鋒。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of the western expedition Gudie was made vanguard.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of the western expedition, Gudie was made vanguard.

units.zh: 夏人伏兵掩之，古叠力戰，麾下士多歿，乃單騎突出。
units.en: Xia troops lay in ambush and struck him; Gudie fought fiercely, many of the men under his command were killed, and he broke out alone on horseback.
units.literal: Xia troops ambushed him with concealed forces; Gudie fought fiercely, many of his soldiers under him perished, and he broke out alone on horseback.

units.zh: 遇夏王李元昊來圍，勢甚急。
units.en: He encountered the Xia ruler Li Yuanhao coming to surround him; the situation grew extremely desperate.
units.literal: He encountered the Xia ruler Li Yuanhao coming to surround him; the situation was extremely pressing.

units.zh: 古叠馳射，應弦輒仆，躍馬直擊中堅，夏兵不能當，晡乃還營。
units.en: Gudie galloped and shot; wherever his arrow struck a man fell; he spurred his horse straight at the enemy center; the Xia troops could not withstand him, and at dusk he returned to camp.
units.literal: Gudie galloped and shot; wherever his arrow struck men fell; he spurred his horse straight at the enemy center; the Xia troops could not withstand him, and at dusk he returned to camp.

units.zh: 改興聖宮太保。
units.en: He was reassigned as grand guardian of the Xingsheng Palace.
units.literal: He was reassigned as Xingsheng Palace grand guardian.

units.zh: 清寧九年，從重元、涅魯古亂，與扈從兵戰，敗而遁，追擒之，陵遲而死。
units.en: In the ninth year of Qingning he joined Chongyuan and Nielugu's rebellion, fought the emperor's escort troops, was defeated and fled, was pursued and captured, and died by dismemberment.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Qingning he joined Chongyuan and Nielugu's rebellion, fought the emperor's escort troops, was defeated and fled, was pursued and captured, and died by dismemberment.

units.zh: 撒剌竹，孟父房滌冽之孫。
units.en: Salazhu was a grandson of the Greater Father house Di Lie.
units.literal: Salazhu was a grandson of the Greater Father house Di Lie.

units.zh: 性凶暴。
units.en: His nature was fierce and brutal.
units.literal: His nature was fierce and brutal.

units.zh: 清寧中，累遷宣徽使，改殿前都點檢，首與重元謀亂。
units.en: During Qingning he was repeatedly promoted to palace commissioner and then made front-hall chief inspector; he was the first to plot rebellion with Chongyuan.
units.literal: During Qingning he was repeatedly promoted to palace commissioner and then changed to front-hall chief inspector; he was first to plot rebellion with Chongyuan.

units.zh: 會帝獵灤河，重元恐事泄，與扈從軍倉卒而戰。
units.en: When the emperor hunted on the Luan River, Chongyuan feared the plot would leak out and fought hastily with the escort troops.
units.literal: When the emperor hunted on the Luan River, Chongyuan feared the affair would leak and fought hastily with the escort troops.

units.zh: 其子涅魯古既死，同黨潰散。
units.en: After his son Nielugu died, the conspirators collapsed and scattered.
units.literal: After his son Nielugu had died, the conspirators collapsed and scattered.

units.zh: 撒剌竹適在畋所，聞亂，劫獵夫以援。
units.en: Salazhu happened to be at the hunting grounds; hearing of the disturbance, he seized huntsmen to come to their aid.
units.literal: Salazhu happened to be at the hunting grounds; hearing of the disturbance, he seized huntsmen to reinforce them.

units.zh: 既至，知涅魯古已死，大悔恨之，謂曰：「我輩惟有死戰，胡為若兒戲，自取殞滅？
units.en: When he arrived and learned Nielugu was already dead, he was filled with bitter regret and said, "Our side has only to fight to the death—why treat this like child's play and bring ruin on ourselves?
units.literal: When he arrived and learned Nielugu was already dead, he greatly regretted it and said, "Our side has only to fight to the death—why act like child's play and bring ruin on ourselves?

units.zh: 今行宮無備，乘夜劫之，大事可濟。
units.en: The mobile palace is now unguarded; raid it by night and the great affair may yet succeed.
units.literal: The mobile palace is now unguarded; raid it by night and the great affair may succeed.

units.zh: 若俟明旦，彼將有備，安知我眾不攜貳？
units.en: If we wait until dawn they will be prepared—who knows whether our men will not turn disloyal?
units.literal: If we wait until dawn they will be prepared—who knows whether our host will not turn disloyal?

units.zh: 一失機會，悔將無及。」
units.en: Once the opportunity is lost, regret will come too late."
units.literal: Once the opportunity is lost, regret will come too late."

units.zh: 重元、蕭胡睹等曰：「今夕但可四面圍之，勿令外軍得入，彼何能備！」
units.en: Chongyuan, Xiao Hudu, and the others said, "Tonight we need only surround them on all four sides and not let outside troops enter—how can they be prepared!"
units.literal: Chongyuan, Xiao Hudu, and others said, "Tonight we need only surround them on all four sides and not let outside troops enter—how can they be prepared!"

units.zh: 不從。
units.en: They would not listen to him.
units.literal: He was not obeyed.

units.zh: 遲明，投仗而走，撒剌竹戰死。
units.en: Near dawn they cast aside their weapons and fled; Salazhu died in battle.
units.literal: Near dawn they cast aside their weapons and fled; Salazhu died in battle.

units.zh: 奚回離保，一名翰，字挼懶，奚王忒鄰之後。
units.en: Xi Huilibao, also named Han, whose courtesy name was Rou Lan, was a descendant of the Xi king Te Lin.
units.literal: Xi Huilibao, also named Han, courtesy name Rou Lan, was a descendant of the Xi king Te Lin.

units.zh: 善騎射，趫捷而勇，與其兄鱉裏剌齊名。
units.en: Skilled at mounted archery, swift and brave, he was as renowned as his elder brother Bie Lila.
units.literal: Skilled at mounted archery, swift and brave, he was as renowned as his elder brother Bie Lila.

units.zh: 大安中，車駕幸中京，補護衛，稍遷鐵鷂軍詳穩。
units.en: During Da'an, when the emperor visited Zhongjing, he was appointed to the guard and was gradually promoted to Iron Hawk Army detail-stable.
units.literal: During Da'an when the emperor visited Zhongjing he was appointed to the guard, and was gradually promoted to Iron Hawk Army detail-stable.

units.zh: 天慶間，徙北女直詳穩，兼知咸州路兵馬事，改東京統軍。
units.en: During Tianqing he was transferred to Northern Jurchen detail-stable, concurrently administered Xianzhou Route military affairs, and was made Eastern Capital supreme commander.
units.literal: During Tianqing he was transferred to Northern Jurchen detail-stable, concurrently knew Xianzhou Route military affairs, and was changed to Eastern Capital supreme commander.

units.zh: 既而諸蕃入寇，番破之，遷奚六部大王，兼總知東路兵馬事。
units.en: Before long, when various frontier peoples invaded, he repeatedly defeated them, was promoted to great king of the Six Xi Tribes, and concurrently oversaw Eastern Route military affairs.
units.literal: Before long when various frontier peoples invaded he repeatedly defeated them, was promoted to great king of the Six Xi Tribes, and concurrently oversaw Eastern Route military affairs.

units.zh: 保大二年，金兵至，天祚播遷，回離保率吏民立秦晉國王淳為帝。
units.en: In the second year of Baoda the Jin troops arrived; Tianzuo was driven into flight; Huilibao led officials and commoners to install the Prince of Qin and Jin, Chun, as emperor.
units.literal: In the second year of Baoda Jin troops arrived; Tianzuo was driven into flight; Huilibao led officials and commoners to install Prince of Qin and Jin Chun as emperor.

units.zh: 淳偽署回離保知北院樞密事，兼諸軍都統，屢敗宋兵。
units.en: Chun falsely appointed Huilibao to administer Northern Court privy affairs and serve concurrently as overall commander of all armies, and he repeatedly defeated Song troops.
units.literal: Chun falsely appointed Huilibao to know Northern Court privy affairs and concurrently overall commander of all armies, and he repeatedly defeated Song troops.

units.zh: 淳死，其妻普賢女攝事。
units.en: When Chun died his wife, Lady Puxian, assumed control of affairs.
units.literal: When Chun died his wife, the Lady Puxian, assumed affairs.

units.zh: 是年，金兵由居庸關入，回離保知北院，即箭笴山自立，號奚國皇帝，改元天復，設奚、漢、渤海三樞密院，改東、西節度使為二王，分司建官。
units.en: That year Jin troops entered through Juyong Pass; Huilibao, who still held Northern Court affairs, at once declared himself independent on Arrow Bamboo Mountain, styled himself emperor of the Xi state, changed the era name to Tianfu, established three privy councils for Xi, Han, and Bohai, changed the eastern and western military commissioners into two kings, and divided offices to establish a government.
units.literal: That year Jin troops entered through Juyong Pass; Huilibao, who still held Northern Court affairs, at once declared himself independent on Arrow Bamboo Mountain, styled himself emperor of the Xi state, changed the era name to Tianfu, established three privy councils for Xi, Han, and Bohai, changed the eastern and western military commissioners to two kings, and divided offices to establish officials.

units.zh: 時奚人巴輒、韓家奴等引兵擊附近契丹部落，劫掠人畜，群情大駭。
units.en: At that time the Xi men Baze and Han Jianu and others led troops against nearby Khitan tribes, plundering people and livestock, and popular feeling was greatly alarmed.
units.literal: At that time the Xi men Baze and Han Jianu and others led troops to attack nearby Khitan tribes, plundering people and livestock; popular feeling was greatly alarmed.

units.zh: 會回離保為郭藥師所敗，一軍離心，其黨耶律阿古哲與其甥乙室八斤等殺之，偽立凡八月。
units.en: When Huilibao was defeated by Guo Yaoshi the whole army lost heart; his faction Yelü Aguzhe and his nephew Yishi Bajin and others killed him; his false reign had lasted only eight months in all.
units.literal: When Huilibao was defeated by Guo Yaoshi the whole army lost heart; his faction Yelü Aguzhe and his nephew Yishi Bajin and others killed him; his false reign lasted only eight months in all.

units.zh: 蕭特烈，字訛都碗，遙輦窪可汗宮分人。
units.en: Xiao Telie, whose courtesy name was Eduo Wan, was from the Yaolian Waqaghan household division.
units.literal: Xiao Telie, courtesy name Eduo Wan, was from the Yaolian Waqaghan household division.

units.zh: 乾統中入宿衛，出為順義軍節度使。
units.en: During Qiantong he entered night guard service and was sent out as military commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
units.literal: During Qiantong he entered night guard service and was sent out as Shunyi Army military commissioner.

units.zh: 天慶四年，同知咸州路兵馬事。
units.en: In the fourth year of Tianqing he was associate administrator of Xianzhou Route military affairs.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tianqing he was associate administrator of Xianzhou Route military affairs.

units.zh: 五年，以兵敗奪節度使。
units.en: In the fifth year, because of defeat in battle, he was stripped of his military commissionership.
units.literal: In the fifth year, because of defeat in battle he was stripped of his military commissionership.

units.zh: 保大元年，遷隗古部節度使。
units.en: In the first year of Baoda he was transferred to military commissioner of the Weigu Tribe.
units.literal: In the first year of Baoda he was transferred to Weigu Tribe military commissioner.

units.zh: 及天祚在山西集群牧兵，特烈為副統軍。
units.en: When Tianzuo gathered tribal herd troops in Shanxi, Telie was made deputy supreme commander.
units.literal: When Tianzuo at Shanxi gathered tribal herd troops, Telie was made deputy supreme commander.

units.zh: 聞金兵將至，特烈諭士卒以君臣之義，死戰於石輦鐸。
units.en: Hearing that Jin troops were about to arrive, Telie instructed the soldiers in the duty between sovereign and subject and fought to the death at Shinian Duo.
units.literal: Hearing that Jin troops were about to arrive, Telie instructed the soldiers in the duty between sovereign and subject and fought to the death at Shinian Duo.

units.zh: 金兵不戰，特烈伺間欲攻之。
units.en: The Jin troops did not engage; Telie watched for an opening and meant to attack them.
units.literal: The Jin troops did not engage; Telie watched for an opening and wished to attack them.

units.zh: 天祚喜甚，召嬪御諸子登高同觀，將詫之。
units.en: Tianzuo was greatly pleased, summoned his consorts and sons to climb high and watch together, intending to boast of the victory.
units.literal: Tianzuo was greatly pleased, summoned consorts and princes to climb high and watch together, intending to boast of it.

units.zh: 金兵望日月旗，知天祚在其下，以勁兵直趨奮擊，無敢當者，天祚遁走。
units.en: The Jin troops saw the sun-and-moon banner, knew Tianzuo was beneath it, sent elite troops straight forward in a fierce assault no one could withstand, and Tianzuo fled.
units.literal: The Jin troops saw the sun-and-moon banner, knew Tianzuo was below it, sent elite troops straight forward in a fierce assault none could withstand, and Tianzuo fled.

units.zh: 特烈所至，招集散亡，尋為中軍都統，復敗於梯已山。
units.en: Wherever Telie went he gathered scattered fugitives; soon he was made central army supreme commander, and was again defeated at Tiyi Mountain.
units.literal: Wherever Telie went he gathered scattered fugitives; soon he was made central army supreme commander, and was again defeated at Tiyi Mountain.

units.zh: 天祚決意渡河奔夏，從臣切諫不聽，人情惶懼不知所為。
units.en: Tianzuo resolved to cross the river and flee to Xia; his attendants remonstrated urgently but he would not listen; the people were fearful and did not know what to do.
units.literal: Tianzuo resolved to cross the river and flee to Xia; his attendants remonstrated urgently but he would not listen; people's hearts were fearful and they did not know what to do.

units.zh: 特烈陰謂耶律兀直曰：「事勢如此，億兆離心，正我輩效節之秋。
units.en: Telie said privately to Yelü Wuzhi, "The situation is thus; the myriad people have lost heart—this is exactly the season for us to give loyal service.
units.literal: Telie said privately to Yelü Wuzhi, "The situation is thus; the myriad people have lost heart—this is exactly the season for us to give loyal service.

units.zh: 不早為計，奈社稷何！」
units.en: If we do not act early, what becomes of the altars of state!"
units.literal: If we do not act early, what becomes of the altars of state!"

units.zh: 遂共劫梁王雅裏，奔西北諸部，偽立為帝，特烈自為樞密使。
units.en: Thereupon together they seized the Prince of Liang, Yali, fled to the northwestern tribes, falsely set him up as emperor, and Telie made himself privy commissioner.
units.literal: Thereupon together they seized Prince of Liang Yali, fled to the northwestern tribes, falsely set him up as emperor, and Telie made himself privy commissioner.

units.zh: 雅裏卒，欲擇可立者。
units.en: When Yali died they wished to choose someone fit to enthrone.
units.literal: When Yali died they wished to choose someone fit to enthrone.

units.zh: 會耶律兀直言朮烈才德純備，兼興宗之孫，眾皆曰可，遂僭立焉，特烈偽職如故。
units.en: Yelü Wuzhi said that Shulie was pure in talent and virtue and moreover a grandson of Xingzong; everyone said he would do, and so they set him up with a usurped title; Telie's false post remained as before.
units.literal: Yelü Wuzhi said that Shulie was pure in talent and virtue and moreover a grandson of Xingzong; all said he would do, and so they set him up with a usurped title; Telie's false post remained as before.

units.zh: 未三旬，與朮烈俱為亂兵所殺。
units.en: Within less than thirty days he and Shulie were both killed by mutinous troops.
units.literal: Within less than thirty days he and Shulie were both killed by mutinous troops.

units.zh: 論曰：遼之秉國鈞，握兵柄，節制諸部帳，非宗室外戚不使，豈不以為帝王久長萬世之計哉。
units.en: Commentary says: In holding the state's balance, grasping military power, and controlling the various tribal encampments, the Liao did not employ anyone who was not of the imperial clan or maternal kin—was this not meant as a plan for an emperor's rule to last ten thousand generations?
units.literal: Commentary says: The Liao in holding the state's balance and grasping military power, controlling the various tribal encampments—they did not employ anyone who was not of the imperial clan or maternal kin; was this not thought a plan for an emperor's lasting rule for ten thousand generations?

units.zh: 及夫肆叛逆，致亂亡，皆是人也。
units.en: Yet when they wildly rebelled and brought chaos and ruin, it was all because of men.
units.literal: Yet when they wildly rebelled and brought chaos and ruin—it was all because of men.

units.zh: 有國家者，可不深戒矣乎！
units.en: For those who possess a state, can they not take this as a profound warning!
units.literal: For those who possess a state, can they not take this as a profound warning!

units.zh: 庚戌，皇孫延禧生。
units.en: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.
units.literal: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.

units.zh: 戊戌，皇子宗真生。
units.en: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.
units.literal: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.

units.zh: 己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。
units.en: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
units.literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

units.zh: 冬十月，西北路酋長遐搭、雛搭、雙古等來降。
units.en: In the tenth winter month Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Northwest Route chieftains Xiadá, Choudá, Shuanggu, and others came to surrender.

units.zh: 戊戌，以蕭革、趙為果、耶律郁、馬保業充來歲賀宋正旦使副。
units.en: On wuxu day Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
units.literal: On wuxu day, appointed Xiao Ge, Zhao Weiguo, Yelü Yu, and Ma Baoye chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

units.zh: 滌冽。
units.en: Dilie.
units.literal: Dilie.

units.zh: 孟父房楚國王之後，不知世次：
units.en: Descendants of the Mengfu House King of Chu; generation unknown:
units.literal: Descendants of the Mengfu House King of Chu; generation unknown:

units.zh: 右係出玄祖簡獻皇帝。
units.en: Right descent line from Emperor Xuanzu the Simple and Offering.
units.literal: Right descent line from Emperor Xuanzu the Simple and Offering.

units.zh: 己丑，以南院樞密使蕭阿速為北府宰相，樞密副使耶律乙辛南院樞密使，惕隱查葛遼興軍節度使，魯王謝家奴武定軍節度使，東京留守吳王貼不西京留守。
units.en: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
units.literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

units.zh: 以耶律乙辛知北院樞密使事。
units.en: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 皇子洪基生。
units.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
units.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

units.zh: 及天祚親征女直，蕭胡篤為先鋒都統，章奴為都監。
units.en: When Tianzuo led a personal campaign against the Jurchen, Xiao Hudu was made vanguard supreme commander and Zhangnu army inspector.
units.literal: When Tianzuo personally campaigned against the Jurchen, Xiao Hudu served as vanguard supreme commander and Zhangnu as army inspector.

units.zh: 上曰：「昔元昊擾邊，宋終不能制，何也？」
units.en: The emperor said: "When Yuanhao once raided the frontier, Song could never bring him to heel—why was that?"
units.literal: The emperor said: "In the past Yuanhao harassed the border and Song could never control him—why?"

units.zh: 耶律韓八 耶律唐古 蕭朮哲
units.en: Yelu Hanba, Yelu Tanggu, and Xiao Paizhe
units.literal: Yelu Hanba, Yelu Tanggu, Xiao Paizhe

units.zh: 蕭朮哲
units.en: Xiao Paizhe
units.literal: Xiao Paizhe

units.zh: 蕭朮哲，字石魯隱，孝穆弟高九之子。
units.en: Xiao Paizhe, style name Shiluyin, was the son of Gao Jiu, younger brother of Xiaomu.
units.literal: Xiao Paizhe, whose style name was Shiluyin, was son of Gao Jiu, younger brother of Xiaomu.

units.zh: 蒲奴裏部長陶得裏叛，朮哲為統軍都監，從都統耶律義先擊之，擒陶得裏。
units.en: When the Punnuli chieftain Taodeli rebelled, Paizhe served as army superintendent and followed the commander-in-chief Yelu Yixian in the attack, capturing Taodeli.
units.literal: When the Punnuli chieftain Taodeli rebelled, Paizhe served as Army Superintendent and followed Commander-in-chief Yelu Yixian to attack, capturing Taodeli.

units.zh: 唐古、術哲經略西北邊，勸農積粟，訓練士卒，敵人不敢犯。
units.en: Tanggu and Paizhe administered the northwestern frontier, promoted farming and accumulated grain, trained the troops, and the enemy did not dare attack.
units.literal: Tanggu and Paizhe managed the northwestern border, urged farming and stored grain, trained soldiers, and the enemy did not dare offend.

units.zh: 以戚屬加監門衛上將軍。
units.en: By virtue of imperial kinship he was made general of the Gate Guards.
units.literal: By imperial kinship he was made General of the Gate Guards.

units.zh: 重熙十三年，將衛兵討李元昊有功，遷興聖宮使。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi he led the guard troops against Li Yuanhao with merit and was promoted to director of the Xingsheng Palace.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi he led guard troops against Li Yuanhao with merit and was promoted to Director of the Xingsheng Palace.

units.zh: 清寧初，為國舅詳穩、西北路招討使，私取官粟三百斛，及代，留畜產，令主者鬻之以償。
units.en: Early in Qingning he was imperial uncle Details Steady and northwest pacification commissioner; he privately took three hundred hu of official grain, and on leaving office left livestock for the custodian to sell in repayment.
units.literal: Early in Qingning he was Imperial Uncle Details Steady and Northwest Pacification Commissioner; he privately took three hundred hu of official grain, and on leaving office left livestock for the custodian to sell in repayment.

units.zh: 咸雍二年，拜北府宰相，為北院樞密使耶律乙辛所忌，誣朮哲與護衛蕭忽古等謀害乙辛。
units.en: In the second year of Xianyong he was appointed northern chancellery chancellor; Yelu Yixin, northern court privy commissioner, envied him and accused Paizhe of plotting with the guardsman Xiao Hugu and others to harm Yixin.
units.literal: In the second year of Xianyong he was appointed Northern Chancellery Chancellor; Yelu Yixin, Northern Court Privy Commissioner, envied him and accused Paizhe of plotting with guardsman Xiao Hugu to harm Yixin.

units.zh: 侄藥師奴。
units.en: His nephew was Yaoshinu.
units.literal: Nephew Yaoshinu.

units.zh: 後族弟胡睹到部發其事，帝怒，決以大杖，免官。
units.en: Later his clansman cousin Hudu came to the post and exposed the matter; the emperor was enraged, sentenced him to the great staff, and removed him from office.
units.literal: Later his clansman cousin Hudu came to the post and exposed the matter; the emperor was angry, sentenced him to the great staff, and removed him from office.

units.zh: 朮哲與義先不協，誣義先罪，免官。
units.en: Paizhe did not get along with Yixian, falsely accused him of a crime, and had him removed from office.
units.literal: Paizhe did not get along with Yixian, falsely accused him of crime, and had him removed from office.

units.zh: 稍遷西南面招討都監，坐事下獄，以太后言，杖而釋之。
units.en: He was gradually promoted to southwest pacification superintendent; for an offense he was imprisoned, but at the empress dowager's word he was beaten with the staff and released.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to Southwest Pacification Superintendent; for an offense he was imprisoned, but at the empress dowager's word he was beaten with the staff and released.

units.zh: 尋起為昭德軍節度使，徵為北院宣徽使。
units.en: Soon he was reappointed military commissioner of Zhaode Army and summoned as northern court palace commissioner.
units.literal: Soon he was reappointed Military Commissioner of Zhaode Army and summoned as Northern Court Palace Commissioner.

units.zh: 九年，上以朮哲先為招討，威行諸部，復為西北路招討使。
units.en: In the ninth year, because Paizhe had earlier served as pacification commissioner and his authority extended through the tribes, he was again made northwest pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the ninth year, because Paizhe had earlier served as pacification commissioner and his authority extended through the tribes, he was again made Northwest Pacification Commissioner.

units.zh: 訓士卒，增器械，省追呼，嚴號令。
units.en: He trained the soldiers, increased weapons, reduced forced levies, and enforced strict orders.
units.literal: He trained soldiers, increased weapons, reduced forced levies, and enforced strict orders.

units.zh: 人不敢犯，邊境晏然。
units.en: No one dared offend him, and the border was tranquil.
units.literal: No one dared offend him; the border was tranquil.

units.zh: 十年，入朝，封柳城郡王。
units.en: In the tenth year he came to court and was enfeoffed as prince of Liucheng commandery.
units.literal: In the tenth year he entered court and was enfeoffed Prince of Liucheng commandery.

units.zh: 詔獄無狀，罷相，出鎮順義軍。
units.en: An imperial investigation found no substance to the charge; he was dismissed as chancellor and sent out to govern Shunyi Army.
units.literal: Imperial investigation found no substance; he was dismissed as chancellor and sent out to govern Shunyi Army.

units.zh: 卒，追王晉、宋、梁三國。
units.en: On his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as king of Jin, Song, and Liang — the three states.
units.literal: On death he was posthumously enfeoffed as king of Jin, Song, and Liang — the three states.

units.zh: 甲子，北府宰相蕭惠為北院樞密使，豳王遂哥為惕隱，惕隱敵魯古封漆水郡王、西北路招討使，樞密副使蕭阿剌同知北院宣徽事。
units.en: On jiazi day Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner; Prince of Bin Suige was made tiyin; tiyin Dirugu was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner; and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.
units.literal: On jiazi day, made Northern Chancellor Xiao Hui Northern Court Privy Commissioner, Prince of Bin Suige tiyin, enfeoffed tiyin Dirugu as Prince of Qishui and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner, and Privy Vice Commissioner Xiao Ala concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 十二年春正月辛未，遣同知析津府事耶律敵烈、樞密院都承旨王惟吉諭夏國與宋和。
units.en: In the twelfth year, on xinwei day of the first spring month Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji were dispatched to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.
units.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, on xinwei day, dispatched Co-administrator of Xijin Prefecture Yelü Dilie and Privy Council chief director Wang Weiji to instruct Xia State to make peace with Song.

units.zh: 十四年春正月庚申，以侍中蕭虛烈為南院統軍使，封遼西郡王。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, on gengshen day of the first spring month, Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie was appointed Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed Prince of Liaoxi.
units.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, on gengshen day, made Palace Attendant Xiao Xulie Southern Court army commander and enfeoffed him Prince of Liaoxi.

units.zh: 甲辰，以同知北院宣徽事蕭阿剌為北府宰相。
units.en: On jiachen day concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala was appointed Northern Chancellor.
units.literal: On jiachen day, made concurrent Northern Court palace affairs commissioner Xiao Ala Northern Chancellor.

units.zh: 宗望伐宋，與郭藥師戰于白河。
units.en: When Zongwang marched on Song he fought Guo Yaoshi at the White River.
units.literal: Zongwang campaigned against Song and fought Guo Yaoshi at the White River.

units.zh: 是時，奚王回離保在盧能嶺，立愛未敢即朝見，先使人來送款曰：「民情愚執，不即順從，願降寬恩，以慰反側。」
units.en: At that time the Xi king Huilibao was at Luneng Ridge. Liai did not dare present himself at court immediately, but first sent a messenger with his submission: "The people are stubborn and did not submit at once. Grant them leniency to calm their fears."
units.literal: At that time the Xi king Huilibao was at Luneng Ridge; Liai did not dare at once to appear at court, but first sent a man with his submission saying: "The people's minds are foolishly stubborn and did not at once submit; grant lenient favor to comfort those wavering."

units.zh: 奚王回離保軍所在保聚，薊州已降複叛。
units.en: The Xi king Huilibao's troops gathered in their strongholds, and Jizhou, though it had surrendered, rebelled again.
units.literal: The Xi king Huilibao's forces gathered at their strongholds; Jizhou had surrendered but rebelled again.

units.zh: 以宰臣劉晟監修國史，牛璘為彰國軍節度使，蕭孝穆為西北路招討使。
units.en: Grand Chancellor Liu Sheng was put in charge of compiling the National History; Niu Lin was made military commissioner of Zhangguo Army; and Xiao Xiaomu was made Northwestern Road pacification commissioner.
units.literal: Grand Chancellor Liu Sheng was put in charge of compiling the National History; Niu Lin was made military commissioner of Zhangguo Army; Xiao Xiaomu was made Northwestern Road pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 丙子，以西北路招討都監蕭孝穆為北府宰相。
units.en: On bingzi day Northwestern Road pacification surveillance commissioner Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Court Grand Chancellor.
units.literal: On bingzi day Northwestern Road pacification surveillance commissioner Xiao Xiaomu was made Northern Court Grand Chancellor.

units.zh: 十二月庚寅，以北大王府布猥帳郎君自言先世與國聯姻，許置敞史，命本帳蕭胡睹為之。
units.en: On gengyin day of the twelfth month, because a langjun of the Northern Great King Household's Buwei Account claimed ancestral marriage ties with the dynasty, permission was granted to establish a chanshi, and Xiao Hudu of that account was appointed to the post.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on gengyin day, because a Northern Great King Household Buwei Account langjun claimed his ancestors had intermarried with the state, permission was granted to establish a chanshi; Xiao Hudu of his account was ordered to fill the post.

units.zh: 甲辰，封皇太弟重元子涅魯古為安定郡王。
units.en: On jiachen day Imperial Grand Younger Brother Chongyuan's son Nielugu was enfeoffed as Duke of Anding Commandery.
units.literal: On jiachen day, enfeoffed Imperial Grand Younger Brother Chongyuan's son Nielugu as Duke of Anding Commandery.

units.zh: 十一年春正月戊申，奉迎皇太后於內殿。
units.en: In the eleventh year, on wushen day of the first spring month the Empress Dowager was escorted into the inner hall.
units.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on wushen day, escorted the Empress Dowager into the inner hall.

units.zh: 天祚皇帝四 耶律淳 耶律雅里 耶律大石子:夷列 夷列妹:普速完 夷列次子:直魯古
units.en: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi — Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu
units.literal: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi: Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu

units.zh: 耶律雅里者，天祚皇帝第二子也，字撒鸞。
units.en: Yelü Yali was Emperor Tianzuo's second son; his style was Saluan.
units.literal: Yelü Yali was Emperor Tianzuo's second son; his style was Saluan.

units.zh: 保大三年，金師圍青塚寨，雅里在軍中。
units.en: In Baoda year 3 Jin troops besieged Green Mound Stockade; Yali was in the army.
units.literal: Baoda year 3, Jin troops besieged Green Mound Stockade; Yali was in the army.

units.zh: 聞天祚失利趨雲內，雅里馳赴。
units.en: Hearing Tianzuo had met defeat and was hastening to Yunnei, Yali galloped to join him.
units.literal: Hearing Tianzuo had met defeat and was hastening to Yunnei, Yali galloped to join him.

units.zh: 仗劍召雅里問曰：「特母哥教汝何為？」
units.en: Drawing his sword he summoned Yali and asked, "What did Temuge teach you to do?"
units.literal: Drawing his sword he summoned Yali and asked, "What did Temuge teach you to do?"

units.zh: 七歲，欲立為皇太子，別置禁衛，封梁王。
units.en: At age seven the court wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.
units.literal: At age seven, [the court] wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.

units.zh: 後三日，群僚共立雅里為主。
units.en: Three days later the assembled officials together set up Yali as lord.
units.literal: Three days later the assembled officials together set up Yali as lord.

units.zh: 雅里遂即位，改元神曆，命士庶上便宜。
units.en: Yali thereupon took the throne, changed the era to Shenli, and ordered gentry and commoners to submit whatever was expedient.
units.literal: Yali thereupon took the throne, changed the era to Shenli, and ordered gentry and commoners to submit whatever was expedient.

units.zh: 後獵查剌山，一日而射黃羊四十，狼二十一，因致疾，卒，年三十。
units.en: Later hunting at Chala Mountain, in one day he shot forty yellow sheep and twenty-one wolves; he thereupon fell ill and died at thirty.
units.literal: Later hunting at Chala Mountain, in one day he shot forty yellow sheep and twenty-one wolves; he thereupon fell ill and died, age thirty.

units.zh: 雅里性寬大，惡誅殺。
units.en: Yali's nature was generous; he hated executions.
units.literal: Yali's nature was generous; he hated executions.

units.zh: 雅里對曰：「無他言。」
units.en: Yali replied, "Nothing else was said."
units.literal: Yali replied, "Nothing else was said."

units.zh: 天祚渡河奔夏，隊帥耶律敵列等劫雅里北走。
units.en: Tianzuo crossed the river fleeing to Xia; company commander Yelü Dilie and others seized Yali and fled north.
units.literal: Tianzuo crossed the river fleeing to Xia; company commander Yelü Dilie and others seized Yali and fled north.

units.zh: 而雅里日漸荒怠，好擊鞠。
units.en: But Yali daily grew negligent and fond of cuju.
units.literal: But Yali daily grew negligent and fond of cuju.

units.zh: 雅里怒曰：「昔畋於福山，卿誣獵官，今復有此言。
units.en: Yali angrily said, "Formerly when hunting at Fushan you slandered the hunt officer; now you again have this speech.
units.literal: Yali angrily said, "Formerly when hunting at Fushan you slandered the hunt officer; now you again have this speech.

units.zh: 雅里乃自為直：每粟一車，償一羊；
units.en: Yali thereupon set the rate himself: for each cart of grain, one sheep;
units.literal: Yali thereupon set the rate himself: for each cart of grain, one sheep;

units.zh: 雅里曰：「民有則我有。
units.en: Yali said, "If the people have, then I have.
units.literal: Yali said, "If the people have, then I have.

units.zh: 然淳與雅里、大石之立，皆在天祚之世。
units.en: Yet the enthronements of Chun, Yali, and Dashi all fell within Tianzuo's lifetime.
units.literal: Yet Chun's, Yali's, and Dashi's establishments were all in Tianzuo's age.

units.zh: 淳、雅里所謂名不正，言不順，事不成者也。
units.en: Of Chun and Yali it is said: when the name is not correct, speech does not accord, and the affair is not accomplished.
units.literal: Chun and Yali are what is called: the name not correct, speech not in accord, the affair not accomplished.

units.zh: 蕭妃攝政，遷簽書樞密院事。
units.en: While Puxiannu, the Virtuous Consort Xiao, governed as regent, he was promoted to signing clerk of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: When Puxiannu, Virtuous Consort Xiao, acted as regent, he was transferred to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 遼主西奔，蕭妃攝政，賜筈進士第，授尚書左司員外郎，寄班閣門。
units.en: When the Liao emperor fled west and Empress Xiao ruled as regent, she granted Kuo the jinshi degree, made him Outer Assistant Director in the Left Office of State Affairs, and attached him to the Imperial Portal.
units.literal: The Liao ruler fled west; Empress Xiao held regency, granted Kuo the jinshi degree, appointed him Outer Assistant Director of the Left Office of the Department of State Affairs, and attached him to the Imperial Portal roster.

units.zh: 太祖至居庸關，蕭妃自古北口遁去，都監高六送款于太祖。
units.en: When Taizu reached Juyong Pass, Empress Xiao slipped away through the Old Northern Pass while Commandant Gao Liu offered his submission to the Jin founder.
units.literal: When Taizu reached Juyong Pass, Empress Xiao fled through the Old Northern Pass; the commandant Gao Liu surrendered to Taizu.

units.zh: 三月戊戌，殿前都點檢蕭叠裏得與夏戰於三角川，敗之。
units.en: On wuxu day of the third month Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.
units.literal: Third month, on wuxu day, Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide fought Xia at Sanjiao River and defeated them.

units.zh: 丙辰，幸殿前都點檢蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉蕭胡睹帳視疾。
units.en: On bingchen day the court visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.
units.literal: On bingchen day, visited Palace Front commander Xiao Dielide and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hudu's tents to inquire after their illnesses.

units.zh: 天祚走天德，秦晉國王耶律捏裏自立于燕，擢彥宗留守判官。
units.en: When Emperor Tianzuo fled to Tiande, Yelü Chun, the prince of Qin and Jin whose childhood name was Nieli, set himself up at Yan and appointed Yanzong assistant to the resident commissioner.
units.literal: When Emperor Tianzuo fled to Tiande, Yelü Chun, whose childhood name was Nieli and who was king of Qin and Jin, declared himself ruler at Yan and promoted Yanzong to assistant to the resident commissioner.

units.zh: 丁未，冊皇后蕭氏，封其父祗候郎君鱉裏剌為趙王，叔西北路招討使餘里也遼西郡王，兄漢人行宮都部署、駙馬都慰霞抹柳城郡王，參知政事楊遵勖知南院樞密使事，北院樞密使副蕭速撒知北院樞密使事，漢人行宮副部署劉詵參知政事。
units.en: On dingwei day Empress Xiao was invested; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu was made administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: On dingwei day invested Empress Xiao; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
